facts.fact: Matias Borges, national director of telecommunications at MINTTICS, said in a May 2023 interview that Angola's terrestrial fibre network exceeds 22,000 km and connects all provincial and communal capitals; no date for the connection is given, so the article date is used.

MINTTICS's national director of telecommunications said Angola's terrestrial fibre network, over 22,000 km, was in place connecting provincial capitals; no date for the connection is given, so the article date is used.
